elements.text: Everything here is the validator, not the renderers. Switch the form's language and watch the messages change without a single error key in this catalog.
Ordinary keyword failures. The wording is Ajv's own, translated by ajv-i18n - this catalog defines no error text at all.
transform normalises the value as a side effect of validating. Blur a field and the stored data changes: trimmed, upper-cased, start-cased, or matched to the nearest declared choice.

A schema default is written into the data on first validation - including false, which is why Confirmed stays unticked rather than being treated as missing. The four below it are computed: today, today plus two weeks, now, and this year.
dynamicDefaults can read the page address, so an object field arrives holding the current request parameters. Add ?ref=AB-1234&campaign=spring to the URL and reload.
dynamic compiles a function written in the schema. It needs jsonformsExtended.security.allowScriptEvaluation, which this example grants; without it the field stays empty and the console says why.
These messages come from the schema, not from the validator. A message may be a catalog key - the first two are - or a sentence, which is used as written.
